answer: Work waits on the ivory until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the lantern of the next round. The design leans on staked peer review with spot checks, taxed when attestations come from one subnet, every claim is re-checked by someone with nothing to gain. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the haven of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short.
